## 主张 Claim

编码后的任意有限二叉接合树得到代码 c，当且仅当原来指定叶子的同一树可在 J 中实现并得到编码为 c 的结果。 / An encoded finite binary joining tree realizes code c exactly when the same tree with its originally specified leaves has a J realization whose result encodes to c.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningBranches.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningBranches.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 同一部分接合 J；每对输入具有有限结果集合。 / One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.
- 目标含全部有限否定、合取、左右接合后继问题，无独立原子谓词。 / The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.
- Exact 给出完整精确答案；Reduced 仅用于最小代码与输出代码的提升。 / Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。 / Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

Where a description lifts the joining, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves (Joining.tree_lifts). The periphery's tree_lifts holds on the spine (Joining.tree_lifts_of_em): excluded middle is named as the hypothesis em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p and used only to identify passing the same branching tests with likeness where outcomes are listed, which is where the periphery reasoned classically; without it, lifting is exactly having one code being a bisimulation (Joining.operation_lifts_iff).
